point: the same subject, baseline corpus, and verifier policy can yield materially different admissibility once evidence-acquisition topology, freshness binding, and observation scope change

policy.name: interactive-admission-gate
policy.logic: allow only if evidence is verifier-bound and fresh within 60s and includes both boot and runtime measurements; otherwise downgrade to audit-only or deny

cases.freshness_binding: verifier nonce n-701 reused via cached attestation result
cases.reason: attestation result is reusable for inventory but lacks fresh runtime scope for interactive admission

cases.freshness_binding: verifier nonce n-701 via relying-party relay
cases.reason: same evidence passes only if relay integrity and trust-anchor checks are part of the contract
evidence is suitable for audit stream but not verifier-specific fresh admission
start/stop capture retains more replayable context than a bare final artifact digest
